regions.today: A dry, bright and crisp day with plenty of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 10 to 13 degrees with light variable breezes.
regions.tonight: Cold and dry tonight with long clear spells and patches of mist and fog forming in light northwesterly or variable breezes. Lowest temperatures of 0 to 4 degrees, with some frost forming in inland areas.
regions.tomorrow: A cool start to Sunday with mist and fog patches clearing during the morning to leave a dry, bright and crisp day with plenty of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 10 to 13 degrees in light variable breezes.
